out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: OBSERVED FOOD EMPLOYEE USING A HANDWASHING SINK TO FILL A PITCHER WITH WATER.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. CDI: EMPLOYEE RE-EDUCATED DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours. OBSERVED COOKED POTATOES AT 48F IN WALK-IN COOLER 2. FOOD WORKER STATED IT WAS COOKED THE NIGHT PRIOR.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. CDI: POTATOES DISPOSED OF DURING THE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Air/Water Thermometers Accuracy, Only Degrees F
violations.observation: The ambient (air/water) temperature measuring device located in the following unit is not accurate in degrees F. The 1 door under counter cooler on the cookline, thermometer was broken
violations.corrective_action: Ambient air and water temperature measuring devices that are scaled only in Fahrenheit shall be accurate to +/-3 degrees F in the intended range of use. PIC replaced thermometer with spare thermometer they had in the facility

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: 2 draw under counter cooler on the cookline,
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. PIC agreed to acquire thermometer, will follow up to verify compliance

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: No heat sensitive test strip available to verify heat sanitization step of mechanical warewashing machine available in the facility during the time of inspection
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature. PIC agreee dot acquire one, will follow up to verify compliance RED LOBSTER (Inspection Date: 02/19/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Pesticides labeled for residential use were observed in the facility and are being applied by the operator to control pests. OBSERVED A CAN OF AERSOL SPRAY PESTICIDE ( RAID) BEING STORED IN THE ELECTRICAL ROOM
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. PERSON IN CHARGE DISPOSED OF THE CAN OF AERSOL BASED PESTICIDE SPRAY RED LOBSTER (Inspection Date: 09/15/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED IN THE DISHWASHING AREA, FLOOR TILE GROUTING HAS BECOME WORN DOWN AND MISSING, RENDERING THE FLOOR TILES NON-WATERPROOF
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. PERSON IN CHARGE AGREED TO HAVE THE FLOOR TILE GROUTING REPAIRED OR REPLACED BY NEXT INSPECTION

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair

violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. PERSON IN CHARGE AGREED TO HAVE THE CEILING TILES REPAIRED OR REPLACED BY NEXT INSPECTION
